determinism_standard.seed: Every generated run records the Hypothesis seed or reproducing example.
determinism_standard.clock: Pure Stage 4 tests use fixed UTC timestamps; runtime clocks must be injected later.
determinism_standard.ordering: All unordered inputs are sorted before canonical serialization.
determinism_standard.versions: Python and direct/transitive dependency versions are evidence-bound.
determinism_standard.paths: Only normalized repository-relative paths enter evidence.
determinism_standard.volatile_fields: Canonical identity rejects or explicitly excludes volatile fields.
determinism_standard.concurrency: Schedules are enumerated and recorded instead of wall-clock raced.
determinism_standard.repeatability: Generated views and validation reports are compared byte-for-byte across two clean runs.
determinism_standard.shrinking: Hypothesis failures retain the minimal reproducing example and database-free seed metadata.

layers.proof_target: Pure canonicalization, parsing, and predicate branches.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Does not prove adapter or service behavior.

layers.proof_target: Canonicalization and ordering properties over generated semantic inputs.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Finite generated examples do not prove all values or managed transports.

layers.proof_target: Lifecycle, checkpoint, proof, publication, and rollback transition legality.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Does not prove distributed storage atomicity.

layers.proof_target: JSON Schema structure plus semantic cross-field rules.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Does not prove producers emit conforming records.

layers.proof_target: Future adapters produce the same canonical state and proof digests as the local oracle.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Stage 4 defines but does not execute adapters.

layers.proof_target: Runtime components exchange versioned records across real local boundaries.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Local integration does not prove AWS services.

layers.proof_target: Crash, retry, duplicate, conflict, stale writer, and rollback outcomes.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Local injection does not establish managed failure rates.
layers.environment: local deterministic simulator now; runtime harness later

layers.proof_target: Future least privilege, encryption, isolation, lifecycle, and teardown controls.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Static Terraform checks do not prove deployed controls.

layers.proof_target: Future bounded throughput, latency, recovery, and cost measurements.
layers.non_proof_boundary: No Stage 4 local result is a performance claim.

layers.proof_target: Commit, run, artifact, resource, label, limitation, and producer-version binding.
layers.non_proof_boundary: Integrity does not prove the underlying system is correct.
